meta.title: Shared loader, pure Claude mapping and OTLP output

architecture.principles: Functional core / imperative shell; constructorinjection; storage-neutral pureadapters; standard-first typedlogrecords, no alternatepersistedmodel; explicitcontentpolicy and boundedI/O.
architecture.composition_root: crates/app/src/main.rs selects explicitstaticadapter and composes SDK genericcollectionservice with FileSessionLoader and OtlpJsonlWriter.
contracts: Source separation: SessionLoader owns listing/storage/framing; SessionAdapter is a pure deterministic data mapper and receives no reader, filesystem, environment, clock, writer, service locator or loader. SDK orchestrates three independently injectable ports. Adapters never open sidecars or attachment paths. Preserve existing configuration APIs.

New core collection types in crates/core/src/collection.rs: SourceScope { root: PathBuf, max_sessions: usize }; SessionRef { path: PathBuf }; SourceIdentity = Unix { device:u64, inode:u64 } | Unavailable; ReadCursor { source:PathBuf, identity:SourceIdentity, offset:u64 }; ReadLimits { max_records:usize, max_record_bytes:usize, max_batch_bytes:usize }, default 128/1048576/4194304, positive and max_batch_bytes>=max_record_bytes. NativeRecord { offset:u64, bytes:Vec<u8> }; LoadedBatch { source:SessionRef, records:Vec<NativeRecord>, next_cursor:ReadCursor, more:bool, incomplete_tail:bool }. No semantic sessionId is invented from a file path. CollectionBatch is CORE-owned: { mapped:MappedBatch,next_cursor:ReadCursor,more:bool,incomplete_tail:bool }. CollectionApi: Send+Sync; fn list_sessions(&self,scope:&SourceScope)->Result<Vec<SessionRef>,PipelineError>; fn collect_batch(&self,session:&SessionRef,cursor:Option<&ReadCursor>,limits:ReadLimits,options:MappingOptions,destination:&mut dyn std::io::Write)->Result<CollectionBatch,PipelineError>. Both methods are object-safe. Baseline testkit supplies FakeCollector implementing CollectionApi for CLI tests, alongside FakeSessionLoader/FakeRecordWriter.

SessionLoader: Send+Sync; fn list_sessions(&self,scope:&SourceScope)->Result<Vec<SessionRef>,PipelineError>; fn read_batch(&self,session:&SessionRef,cursor:Option<&ReadCursor>,limits:ReadLimits)->Result<LoadedBatch,PipelineError>. Explicit absolute file/root required. File loader listing is deliberately NONRECURSIVE for this first slice: immediate regular .jsonl files in the explicit directory, sorted by native path, reject oversize result rather than truncate silently; skip symlink entries. Read an explicitly selected regular file, reject final symlink (Unix nofollow), never autodiscover sidecars. Directory ancestors are caller-selected trusted scope, not a hostile-filesystem sandbox claim. SourceScope.max_sessions==0 returns InvalidInput. FileSessionLoader rejects non-UTF8 root/session paths at listing/read boundaries, with InvalidInput before opening/returning a bad path. Pure adapters also reject a caller-supplied non-UTF8 SessionRef as InvalidInput rather than lossy coercion because SDK callers may bypass FileSessionLoader. Loader is explicitly Unix-only for this release: on non-Unix BOTH list_sessions and read_batch fail fast Unsupported before I/O; no misleading first-batch-only success. Pure mapper/writer/core do not inherit that platform restriction. CLI list response includes recursive:false, explicit root and sessions; --help/docs require the leaf project directory and explain empty results, not implicit recursive discovery.

Loader semantics: bounded LF framing, NativeRecord bytes exclude LF but retain CR; blank lines consume physical max_records budget and cursor but are omitted from returned records. Never allocate based on full file length. Observe end-of-file length once per call; do not chase live appends. Incomplete final bytes cause incomplete_tail=true and cursor remains after last complete LF; more=false at that observed boundary so CLI does not spin. A capacity stop with unread complete/unknown bytes sets more=true. ReadCursor binds exact selected path, identity and boundary offset; wrong path, source rotation/truncation, non-boundary offset or unsupported resume identity is a typed error, not automatic reset. Same-inode in-place rewriting/regrowth cannot be fully detected and is explicitly unsupported; no exactly-once/source-journal promise. Oversize physical record returns RecordLimit at the record START offset, no batch or next cursor returned; caller retains previous cursor and can retry SAME cursor with larger max_record_bytes and compatible max_batch_bytes to recover all data. CLI remedy names --max-record-bytes and --max-batch-bytes, never skips the record. Batch capacity with prior complete records returns that prior batch/more=true; it does not consume the next record. ReadLimits has public fields and validate()->Result<(),PipelineError>; FileSessionLoader and SDK collect_batch call it before any I/O/port invocation. Invalid positives or max_batch_bytes<max_record_bytes are InvalidInput. Byte accounting includes original LF/CR physical bytes and uses checked arithmetic; returned NativeRecord slices omit LF only.

Pure result types: TelemetryRecord { event_name:String, timestamp_unix_nano:Option<u64>, attributes:BTreeMap<String,serde_json::Value>, body:Option<serde_json::Value> }; MappingOptions { include_content:bool } defaults false; MappingDiagnostic { offset:u64, code:MappingDiagnosticCode }; MappingDiagnosticCode = UnsupportedRecord | UnsupportedPart | InvalidField | InvalidTimestamp | ContentOmitted; MappedBatch { records:Vec<TelemetryRecord>, diagnostics:Vec<MappingDiagnostic> }. SessionAdapter: Send+Sync; fn name(&self)->&'static str; fn map(&self, source:&SessionRef, records:&[NativeRecord], options:MappingOptions)->Result<MappedBatch,PipelineError>. This slice emits source-derived record fragments, not reconstructed whole conversations, so no speculative adapter state object is required. Replay of equal input yields equal mapping.

Failure contract: separate PipelineError with public PipelineErrorKind = InvalidInput | Read | SourceChanged | RecordLimit | BatchLimit | ListingLimit | OutputLimit | InvalidData | Write | Unsupported; PipelineError::new(kind:PipelineErrorKind,offset:Option<u64>)->Self, kind()/offset()/code()/message()/fix() accessors; fixed code/message/fix, Display/Error, no raw serde/OS/source bytes in diagnostics. Codes UNI-INPUT/UNI-READ/UNI-SOURCE-CHANGED/UNI-LIMIT-RECORD/UNI-LIMIT-BATCH/UNI-LIMIT-LISTING/UNI-LIMIT-OUTPUT/UNI-DATA/UNI-WRITE/UNI-UNSUPPORTED. No changes to existing configuration Failure taxonomy. Each limit kind has distinct fixed remediation: increase record and compatible batch limit; decrease batch size/increase selected batch budget; increase max_sessions or narrow scope; reduce output batch/content size. RecordLimit offset is physical record start, batch/output offsets optional and listing offset None. Errors never return a committed cursor. Unsupported explains the Unix-only file-loader boundary; no arbitrary OS error text.

Claude mapping profile v1: each supported physical record emits event_name=unisphere.session.record, an explicitly nonstandard source-derived event, NEVER falsely gen_ai.client.inference.operation.details. All outputs have unisphere.profile.version=1, unisphere.source.adapter=claude-code, unisphere.source.path (explicit supplied UTF8path), unisphere.source.offset (physical byte offset) and unisphere.source.kind. Native uuid->unisphere.source.record.id, parentUuid->unisphere.source.parent.id, message.id->unisphere.message.id, declared sessionId->gen_ai.conversation.id when present. isSidechain preserves unisphere.source.is_sidechain; never infer ownership/parentsession relationship. Repeated message.id records remain distinct by provenance; do not dedupe or sum their usage. Only observed message.model -> gen_ai.response.model; never invent provider name or trace/span IDs. Normative key registry lives ONLY in docs/telemetry-profile.md (writer lane owns it); docs/claude-adapter.md references that registry and explains native extraction, not an independently divergent namespace. All listed keys are emitted by the adapter, writer preserves them. Required keys/types: unisphere.profile.version integer1; unisphere.source.adapter string from SessionAdapter::name; unisphere.source.path string; unisphere.source.offset nonnegative integer; unisphere.source.kind raw native type string when present, literal unknown otherwise. Optional ID/model/conversation keys above are strings; is_sidechain and content.omitted booleans. Unknown native kinds preserve their native type string without raw payload, with UnsupportedRecord diagnostic; missing or nonstring type uses unknown and InvalidField. Event_name is category, not instance identity; physical provenance distinguishes records.

Content mapping: supported user/assistant native records have message role retained as unisphere.message.role; when include_content=true, body is a structured GenAI-shaped message {role,parts}, not stringified JSON and not claimed full input-history/output-choice. Native string content -> text part; text.text -> {type:text,content}; thinking.thinking -> {type:reasoning,content}; tool_use -> {type:tool_call,id?,name,arguments:structured input}; tool_result -> {type:tool_call_response,id:tool_use_id?,response:structured content}. Preserve is_error as explicitly namespaced part property unisphere.is_error when supplied. Unknown part -> diagnostic and optional generic part {type:unisphere.unknown,native_type,...} only with content opt-in; document not full-byte fidelity. Metadata-only drops all message bodies/tool arguments/results/thinking/unknown payloads and records ContentOmitted plus unisphere.content.omitted=true when content exists. No attachment dereference. Unknown record kind returns provenance-only record plus UnsupportedRecord diagnostic, no rawpayload by default or invisible dropping.

Claude timestamp: parse native RFC3339 with time crate, convert valid nonnegative nanoseconds fittingu64 into timestamp_unix_nano; missing remains None, invalid/out-ofrange omitted with diagnostic, never stamp wallclock inside mapper. Usage numbers must be nonnegative representable integers; retain native component counters in unisphere.usage.* source-snapshot attributes, scope explicitly native_record_snapshot. Do NOT emit gen_ai.usage totals or aggregate across repeated records until provider counter inclusion semantics are proven; no absent->zero or overlapping cache addition. This is the smallest documented semantic extension rather than falsely standardizing an unverified total. Closed usage snapshot keys: unisphere.usage.input_tokens, unisphere.usage.output_tokens, unisphere.usage.cache_read_input_tokens, unisphere.usage.cache_creation_input_tokens, each optional integer0..i64::MAX copied only from the identical native message.usage component key (cache_creation_input_tokens maps by exact spelling). If any retained component exists, unisphere.usage.scope string=native_record_snapshot. Wrong type/negative/out-of-range components are omitted with InvalidField diagnostic; unknown components are not guessed or summed. Missing usage remains absent. No other usage keys are emitted in v1.

Output port RecordWriter: Send+Sync; fn write_batch(&self, records:&[TelemetryRecord], destination:&mut dyn std::io::Write)->Result<(),PipelineError>. OtlpJsonlWriter owns encoding only, no file open/env/network. One nonempty batch -> one LF-terminated LogsData object {resourceLogs:[{scopeLogs:[{scope:{name:unisphere,version:0.1.0},logRecords:[...]}]}]}. Empty batch emits nothing and succeeds. record eventName/timeUnixNano/body/attributes follow lowerCamelCase OTLP. AnyValue recursively uses stringValue/boolValue/intValue decimalstring/doubleValue/arrayValue.values/kvlistValue.values; JSON null->empty AnyValue {}; reject JSON integer outside i64 instead of changing its meaning. timeUnixNano is u64decimalstring; no fake trace IDs, no mixedsignals. MAX_OUTPUT_BATCH_BYTES=33_554_432 (32MiB), exported from core, bounds the encoded batch buffer including LF. Serialize through a capped std::io::Write buffer that refuses growth over the cap; do not serialize unbounded then measure. Limit breach returns OutputLimit before touching destination; no cursor advances. Complete serialization into this capped batch buffer before writing; write_all+flush and return typedWrite on failure. Write failure may leave partial bytes; no rollback/exactly-once promise. Exact schema pin: opentelemetry-proto@bb8796bff67cf6e1c7f218e21de6eaec0841871e opentelemetry/proto/logs/v1/logs.proto, verified LogRecord.event_name field12 sincev1.5.0; JSON encoding per that revision. Message-part reference semantic-conventions-genai@94f432d7126f5884d30a2cdde6f4e89908ebb6fd model/gen-ai/gen-ai-input-messages.json. Top-level only resourceLogs; ResourceLogs intentionally omits resource (unknown attribution) and schemaUrl, ScopeLogs has scope/logRecords. severityNumber/severityText/observedTimeUnixNano/flags/traceId/spanId intentionally omitted (no observed values/correlation); absent native timestamp omits timeUnixNano. This is source-derived LogsData conversion, not an instrumented GenAI inference span. Normative profile documents the absence/default interpretation. Tests assert legalkeyset and do not require unsupported optional fields.

SDK service collects a single batch through public fn collect_batch(loader:&dyn SessionLoader,adapter:&dyn SessionAdapter,writer:&dyn RecordWriter,session:&SessionRef,cursor:Option<&ReadCursor>,limits:ReadLimits,options:MappingOptions,destination:&mut dyn Write)->Result<CollectionBatch,PipelineError>. CollectionBatch is the frozen core type above. SDK implements Collector<L,A,W> with new(loader:L,adapter:A,writer:W) and impl CollectionApi; list delegates to loader, collect_batch calls the same service path. CLI only imports the core CollectionApi/CollectionBatch and uses FakeCollector in tests, never SDK/concrete adapter types. It validates bounded loader output against supplied limits, invokes pure mapper, writes mapped records then returns checkpoint only on success; no source/output mutation or cursor persistence hidden in SDK. Reexport core collection contracts from SDK. CLI may loop batches, but no durable checkpoint file or watchdaemon in this slice; SDKcaller owns cursor persistence and output acceptance policy.

CLI/PMcomposition: add sessions list --root ABS_PATH and sessions export --adapter claude-code --input ABS_PATH [--output PATH] [--include-content] [--max-records N] [--max-record-bytes N] [--max-batch-bytes N]. Relative CLIpaths resolved against explicit CliContext.cwd; SDKrequires absolute. List uses versioned JSON on stdout; export always emits OTLPJSONL stdout or create_new explicit outputfile, no silent overwrite. Export summary/diagnostics go stderr, never telemetry stdout. Invalidargs exit2, operational errors1, success0; incomplete tail reports honest partial summary and stops. Keep existing config check/help/version behavior; roothelp advertises sessionscommands. App selects adapters by explicit staticregistry/factory; no dynamicplugins or envdiscovery. CLIfrontend uses injected collection functions/port, never direct concrete adapter imports; app is concretecomposition boundary. Public CLI integration uses a separate run_sessions(args,context:&CliContext,collector:&dyn CollectionApi,stdout,stderr)->u8 entry point; old run signature/behavior remains for existing config usecases (not a compatibility alias). App routes sessions to the new entry and config/help/version to existing frontend, with roothelp explicitly advertising sessions. list --max-sessions controls SourceScope cap; missing/no.jsonl leaf directory returns empty sessions with recursive:false and explanatory stderr diagnostic, never claims recursive search. Error remedies identify concrete limit flags. Export adapterselection is validated in app/static registry without granting I/O to mapper.

Crates: new unisphere-loader-jsonl -> core + targetunix libc; unisphere-adapter-claude -> core+serde_json+time (parsing,std only); unisphere-output-otlp -> core+serde_json. Core adds serde_json solely for structured portable values; no fs/env/network/process/unsafe. Each newcrate devdepends testkit. Existing SDK collection service imports only corecontracts/stdtypes. PMapp composition depends on SDK/CLI and concrete newcrates. Constructor injection, no globalstate. Newtime/libc direct deps declared once in root atbaseline; no source-shaped custom JSON parser/date parser. Dependencychecks updated to reflect actual approvedgraph, including existing SDKdirectserde. Keep root workspace internal path-dependency declarations at baseline, uninherited until each real package exists, following the already-exercised Plan001 pattern; no missing directories appear as explicit workspace members. The actual vd1 baseline run must prove independence with all three future package directories absent before release; if it fails, fix root declarations before seal, not by adding stubs. Do not mutate a frozen root manifest merely to add inherited paths in wave2.

Extension affordance: testkit supplies reusable pure-adapter conformance helper asserting determinism/source-provenance/contentpolicy/outputbounds on fixture inputs. docs/adapters.md includes a complete functional synthetic text-record adapter example and one explicit app registration entry; a test proves it composes through public interfaces without core/Claude edits. Do not create a dynamic plugin framework or a generator that emits fake success/TODO implementation; shared contracts+workingtemplate are the scaffolding for ordinary next adapters. Purity proof is two layers, not a graph-only claim: current architecture metadata check is extended with a SOURCE scan over non-test production core and adapter-claude sources, denying direct/import-tree references to std::{fs,env,process,net,thread}, clock reads std::time::{SystemTime,Instant}::now, unsafe blocks/extern FFI and include_str!/include_bytes! in adapter production. Core may name std::io::Write as a port type but must not invoke filesystem/env/network/process/clock APIs. `#![forbid(unsafe_code)]` remains. Negative synthetic source fixtures exercise fully-qualified and grouped imports, clock call and includedfile macros and must fail. The lexical scan is an advisory static sensor with documented false-negative bound for aliases/macro expansion/indirect calls; independent source review is the complementary judgement, never claim a formal no-I/O proof from regex. Tests contain fixtures/threads legitimately; scan must distinguish #[cfg(test)] testmodules or use explicitly enumerated production files without test bodies.

Knownruntime posture: Builder remains dogfood with useful CLIrecords and honestwarnings. Never lose work or fabricate proof when ownership/receipt tooling blocks; report exactissue and apply already-authorized non-destructive workflow workaround. Preserve requested independent Opusreview and actualproduct tests. Coders author fullcode/tests/docs, PMruns validation; PM mechanicalformat/integration ownership must be explicit rather than repeated baseline ceremony. No private stores, no networksource, no remote publish/globalconfig/retirement.

fan_out.rationale: Three independent lanes consume only PM corecontracts+fixtures: loader, pureClaudeadapter and OTLPwriter; none waitsfor or imports siblings. PMowns end-to-endcomposition andrequestedfreshOpusreview.

capabilities.path: An application can inject a SessionLoader and choose a pure adapter without a filesystem or CLI dependency in the adapter; the same provided native data/state/options produces the same contracted result.

The shared file loader lists candidate sessions deterministically within an explicit source scope and reads bounded native batches; it neither interprets Claude content nor implicitly scans HOME or follows out-of-scope sidecars/symlinks.

Batch reads support explicit caller-owned resume positions, make progress across blank lines, retain incomplete final JSONL records without advancing beyond them, and report changed/truncated/replaced sources instead of silently losing data; unsupported source identity is named.

The Claude adapter maps user/assistant messages and supported text/reasoning/tool-call/tool-result parts, native identity/parent/session links, model and usage facts where present; repeated logical message IDs do not silently erase physical source records or fabricate a full inference operation.

Malformed or unsupported native records/parts, absent fields and source fragments have explicit diagnostics/provenance rather than panic, guessed values or an unqualified lossless/full-session claim; malformed bytes are not echoed in public errors.

The output writer emits valid UTF-8 OTLP LogsData JSONL with correct structured AnyValue/64-bit timestamp encoding and a documented standard-first semantic profile; native-only semantics use clearly named extensions, not invented standard attributes.

The SDK collection service composes loader, pure adapter and injected destination, returning a next checkpoint only after the batch is accepted by the output; output/read/map failures retain actionable error context without falsely advancing successful progress or claiming exactly-once writes.

Content collection/export is explicit: metadata-only is the conservative default and the caller/CLI can opt into message content; omitted/redacted/unsupported content is distinguished, and attachment references are never dereferenced implicitly.

The CLI can list explicit session inputs and export a selected Claude file to stdout or an explicitly selected file using the same SDK pipeline; machine diagnostics do not corrupt OTLP stdout and file creation does not silently overwrite existing data.
